how: Named by hand on 2026-10-06 (user, French titles; English renders translated) on the K=4 refit of run 20261001 rebuilt on 2026-10-05, 15 chains (8 seed 42 + 7 seed 43, merged with fit.py --merge-chains). The posterior has five modes; the names are read on the best one (mode A, chains 0, 1, 2, 4, 5: best log-density) and hold on its converged sub-group {2, 4, 5}, which every deliverable reads since 2026-10-06 (the modes file's selected_chains: best integrated LOO), with the axes tracked across draws by the collinearity of their loading columns (rotation.canonicalize_factors, 2026-10-06). The top benchmarks are those of chains 2, 4, 5 by share of their loading variance. A title is applied only while one of its signature benchmarks stays among the axis's top benchmarks by share.
